name: osano
description: Unofficial Pulumi provider for managing Osano Cookie Consent and Unified Consent resources. Not affiliated with Pulumi Corporation or Osano, Inc.

nodejs.packageDescription: Pulumi provider for Osano Cookie Consent and Unified Consent APIs.

python.packageDescription: Pulumi provider for Osano Cookie Consent and Unified Consent APIs.

apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the Osano Unified Consent API. Override only when targeting a custom domain (default https://uc.api.osano.com).

customerBaseUrl.description: Override base URL for the Customer REST API (default: https://api.osano.com).

osanoApiKey.description: Osano API key used for subject profile routes and Customer REST API/CMP operations (set via pulumi config set osano:osanoApiKey --secret or OSANO_API_KEY).

requestTimeoutSeconds.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds for Customer REST API and Unified Consent calls (default 60).

ucApiKey.description: Unified Consent API key for the Unified Consent Core API (x-uc-api-key).

osano:index:Consent.description: Creates unified consent decisions within Osano for a given subject.

actions.description: Consent actions referencing privacy protocols (target) within a configuration (vendor).

attributes.description: Optional key/value attributes stored with the consent record (e.g., ipAddress overrides).

consentId.description: Synthetic identifier used by Pulumi to track consent submissions.

jurisdiction.description: Optional jurisdiction override matching one of the configuration's jurisdictions.

lastSynced.description: Timestamp of the last refresh from the Osano API (RFC3339).

origin.description: Origin metadata for the consent, typically 'api' or 'gpc'.

subject.description: Subject identifiers used for the consent (verifiedId or anonymousId).

tags.description: Custom tags that Osano associates with the consent record.

osano:index:CookieConsentConfig.description: Manages an Osano Cookie Consent (CMP) configuration.

configuration.description: CMP configuration object. At minimum, must include storagePolicyHref.

created.description: Unix timestamp when Osano created the configuration.

customerId.description: The Osano customer ID that owns the configuration.

domains.description: Domains permitted to host the configuration.

lastPublished.description: Unix timestamp when Osano last published the configuration.

mode.description: Compliance mode: debug, permissive, or production.

orgIds.description: Optional organization IDs associated with the config.

publishStatus.description: Current Osano publication status for the configuration.

publishedRevision.description: Revision number most recently published by Osano.

tattleRecordStopped.description: Whether Osano stopped the tattle record. Deleting this Pulumi resource retains the upstream configuration.

updated.description: Unix timestamp when Osano last updated the configuration.

domains.description: Domains permitted to host the configuration.

mode.description: Compliance mode: debug, permissive, or production.

orgIds.description: Optional organization IDs associated with the config.

osano:index:CookieConsentPublication.description: Publishes an Osano Cookie Consent configuration, waits for completion, and returns its hosted CMP script. Import with the Osano config ID; deleting this resource only removes Pulumi state and does not unpublish the config.

changeToken.description: A caller-managed desired-state token. Changing it queues a new publication; an unchanged token is a no-op.

configId.description: The Osano Cookie Consent config ID to publish. This is also the import ID.

customerId.description: The Osano customer ID that owns the published configuration.

description.description: Optional description sent with the publication request.

keepUnclassifiedTattles.description: Whether publication preserves unclassified discoveries. Defaults to true to avoid unexpected deletion.

lastPublished.description: Unix timestamp of the completed Osano publication.

publishStatus.description: The publication status returned by Osano after completion.

publishedRevision.description: The configuration revision most recently published by Osano.

scriptSrc.description: The public hosted Osano CMP JavaScript URL for this customer and config.

scriptTag.description: The complete public CMP script tag to place first in the site head, without async or defer attributes.

webhookUrl.description: Optional absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL notified by Osano after publication.

osano:index:CookieConsentRule.description: Manages an Osano Cookie Consent (CMP) rule within a configuration.

classification.description: Classification: ANALYTICS, BLACKLISTED, ESSENTIAL, HIDDEN, MARKETING, or PERSONALIZATION.

configId.description: The configId of the Cookie Consent Configuration this rule belongs to.

created.description: Timestamp when the rule was created.

description.description: Optional cookie description. Only supported for cookies; max 1000 characters.

disclosure.description: Whether the rule should be disclosed. Defaults to false.

expiry.description: Optional cookie expiry description. Only supported for cookies; max 50 characters.

rule.description: The rule pattern (e.g. a cookie name pattern). Min 3, max 1000 characters.

ruleType.description: Optional matching mode: FILENAME, DOMAIN, PATH, REGEXP, STARTS_WITH, ENDS_WITH, CONTAINS, or EXACT_MATCH.

storeType.description: The storage type category: cookies, scripts, iframes, or localStorage.

title.description: Optional title for the rule, used in consent disclosure. Max 64 characters.

updated.description: Timestamp when the rule was last updated.

vendorName.description: Optional vendor name for the rule. Max 100 characters.

osano:index:checkConsent.description: Checks whether a unified consent record exists for a given subject ID.

osano:index:getCollection.description: Retrieves a specific privacy protocol collection by ID.

osano:index:getCollections.description: Retrieves the aggregated privacy protocol collections for an optional jurisdiction and version (published/draft).

osano:index:getConfig.description: Retrieves the Unified Consent configuration referenced by the API key.

osano:index:getConsentProfile.description: Retrieves a consent profile for a hashed subject identifier and config ID.

osano:index:getSubject.description: Fetches subject identifiers (subject, verified, anonymous IDs) for a reference or session ID.

osano:index:getUnifiedConsent.description: Fetches the unified consent state for a subject reference using the Unified Consent API key.

osano:index:sendSubjectCode.description: Sends a verification code to a subject's email or phone using the Osano API key.

osano:index:verifySubjectCode.description: Verifies a subject profile using the code sent via email or SMS.
